ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all of campus with an enrollment limit to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this required course on Monday, December 14, 2020 at approximately 10:00a.m. Gies College of Business students on campus MUST register for the in-class option. Gies College of Business students are required to register for the in-class option of this course. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Gies College of Business. Not intended for Nondegree major(s) or minor(s).
